endpoints.notes: Namespace http://ecom.dbbl/. Amount in paisa (legacy jar; unconfirmed for SOAP). Bad credentials -> 'Wrong Merchant ID' (observed live). Duplicate/invalid-input error strings are simulator-invented. Magic scenario SIM:<name> in txnrefnum.

Success 'RESULT: OK / RESULT_PS: FINISHED / RESULT_CODE: 000'; cancel 'RESULT: TIMEOUT / RESULT_PS: CANCELLED' (banglapay samples). FAILED (116) and PENDING lines are simulator-invented. Unknown transid -> 'RESULT>Invalid Transaction ID' (observed). The difference between getresult and getresultrocket is undocumented; the simulator answers both the same.

endpoints.notes: In real mode PaySim 302s to DBBL's own ClientHandler.

endpoints.purpose: Simulator-only mock page step/button handler; ends with the browser return
endpoints.notes: Browser returns to the app's return_url with ?trans_id=<id> (unsigned; confirm with getresult).

notes: DBBL publishes the WSDL but no prose docs; message formats come from the legacy banglapay integration.
No IPN and no refund API are documented. Simulator refunds are dashboard/ledger only; real refunds happen in the DBBL merchant panel.
The Rocket cardtype code is assigned by DBBL per merchant.
